verdict.rationale: Kit documents a webhooks system that reacts to account activity and signs every payload with a secret for verification, giving developers a documented, signed webhook mechanism (kit-docs-21, kit-docs-24). However, the evidence pack never enumerates the specific event types (sends, opens, clicks, bounces, unsubscribes) that can be subscribed to, so full coverage of the story's event list is unconfirmed. Missing for 10: explicit documentation listing engagement/delivery event types (opens, clicks, bounces, unsubscribes, sends) as subscribable webhook topics, and independent confirmation of payload format.
